धारा 38 की उपधारा (2) के खंड (क) द्व ारा प्र ित्त िजततयक का प्र ययोगग करते एए, राष्‍टरीय जडिाइन संस्ट्थान , असं ंें जनिेिक के पि के जलए जनम्नजलजखत जनयं , जवजनयं , भती की पद्धजत , वेतन, भत्ते रर सेवा की अन्य िततें बनाती ै , अथाधत् :- 1. संजिप् त नां रर प्र ारंभ —(1) इन जनयंक का संजिप्त नां जनिेिक , राष्‍टरीय जडिाइन संस्ट्थान , असं (भती, वेतन, भत्ते रर सेवा की अन्य िततें ) जनयं , 2020 ै । (2) ये रािप् ंें इनके प्र कािन की तारीख कयोग प्र वृत्त ै कगे । 2. पररभाषाएं - (1) - इन जनयंक ंें , िब तक दक संिभध से अन्यथा अपेजित न ै योग ,- (क) ‘अजधजनयं ’ से राष्‍टरीय जडिाइन संस्ट्थान अजधजनयं , 2014 (2014 (ग) ‘जनिेिक’ से संस्ट्थान का जनिेिक अजभप्रेत ै ; (घ) ‘संस्ट्थान ’ से राष्‍टरीय जडिाइन सं स्ट्था न, असं अजभप्रेत ै ; (ङ) ‘चयन सजंजत ’ से कें द्रीय सरकार द्व ारा अजधजनयं की धारा 18 की उपधारा (2) के अधीन संस्ट्थान के जलए गरित चयन सजंजत अजभप्रेत ै । (2) इन जनयंक ंें प्र युतत ि्‍ि रर पि, जिन् ैें पररभाजषत नैकि दकया गया ै , परंतु राष्‍टरीय जडिाइन अजधजनयं , 2014 ंें पररभाजषत दकया गया ै , के वैी अथध ै कगे ियोग उनके उस अजधजनयं ंें ैैं । 3. जनिेिक की जनयुजतत के जलए िजिक अै ध ताएं, अनु भव, आदि-- कयोगई व् यजतत जनिेिक के पप ंें जनयुतत नैकि दकया िाएगा, यदि उसके पास - (क) इंिीजनयररंग या प्र ौ्योगजगकी या जडिाइन ंें ं ास्ट्टर जड्ी नैकि ै ; (ख) उसके पास अध्यापन या उ्योगग या अनुसंधान ंें कं से कं पन्द्रै वषध का अनुभव ै योगना चाजैए ; (ग) उसके पास प्र ौ्योगजगकी या जडिाइन के िे् ंें राष्‍टरीय या अंतरराष्‍टरीय अजभा मता ंें दकए गए ंैत् वपूणध ययोगगिान का जसद्ध अजभलेख ै योगना चाजैए । 4. जनयुजतत की पद्धजत -- (1) जनिेिक के पि पर भती कें द्रीय सरकार द्व ारा गरित चयन सजंजत द्व ारा की िाएगी । (2) चयन सजंजत जनिेिक के पि पर दकसी उपयुतत व् यजतत की जसराररि करने के जलए इसकी अपनी प्र दकया का अनुसरण करेगी । 5. जनरै ध ता- वै व् यजतत - क. जिसने ऐसे व् यजतत से जिसका पजत या जिसकी पत्नी िीजवत ै , जववाै दकया ै ; या ख. जिसने अपने पजत या पत्नी के िीजवत रैते एए दकसी व् यजतत से जववाै दकया ै , उतत पि पर जनयुजतत का पा् नैकि ै योगगा : परंतु यदि कें द्रीय सरकार का यै संाधान ै योग िाता ै दक ऐसा जववाै ऐसे व् यजतत रर जववाै के अन्य पिकार कयोग लागू स्ट् वीय जवजध के अधीन अनुा मेय ै रर ऐसा करने के जलए अन्य आधार ैैं तयोग वै दकसी व् यजतत कयोग इस जनयं के प्र वतधन से छूट िे सकेगी । 6. जिजथल करने की िजतत- िैां कें द्र ीय सरकार की यै राय ै दक ऐसा करना आवश्यक या संीचीन ै , वैां वै उसके जलए ियोग कारण ै ैं , उन् ैें लेखबद्ध करके , सिं प्र ाजधकारी से परांिध करके , इन जनयंक के दकसी उपबंध कयोग दकसी वगध या प्र वगध के व् यजततयक की बाबत, आिेि द्व ारा जिजथल कर सकेगी । 7. पिावजध- जनिेिक उस तारीख से, िब वै पि ्ै ण करता ै , पांच वषध की अवजध के जलए या साि वषध की आयु प्र ाप्त करने तक, ियोग भी पूवधतर ै योग , पि धारण करेगा । 8. पि त् याग रर संाजप्त - (1) जनिेिक यदि अपना पि त् यागना चाैता ै तयोग अध्यि कयोग जलजखत पप ंें तीन ं ास पूवध नयोगरटस िेगा : परंतु िब तक कें द्रीय सरकार द्व ारा िीघ्र पि त् याग अनुा मात नैकि दकया िाता ै , तब तक जनिेिक नयोगरटस की अवजध के अवसान तक या सम्यक् पप से जनयुतत उसका प्र ाजधकारी पि ्ै ण नैकि करता ै या उसकी पिावजध के अवसान तक, ियोग भी पूवधतर ै योग , पि धारण करेगा । 2) कें द्रीय सरकार दकसी व् यजतत कयोग जनिेिक के पि से ै टा सकेगी, यदि- (क) उसे दिवाजलया घयोगजषत दकया गया ै ; या (ख) उसे दकसी अपराध ंें ियोगषजसद्ध िैराया गया ै , जिसंें कें द्र ीय सरकार की राय ंें न जतक अधंता अंतवधजलत ै ; या P-24024/53/2020-IPR-V 282185/2021/IPR-V 571/1231 -- 2 of 117 -- [भाग II—खण्ड 3(i)] भारत का रािप् : असाधारण 3 (ग) वै िारीररक या ं ानजसक पप से जनिेिक के पप ंें कायध करने ंें असंथध ै योग गया ै योग ; या (घ) उसने ऐसे जवत्तीय या अन्य जैत प्र ाप्त दकए ै क , ियोग जनिेिक के पप ंें उसके कृ त्यक पर संभाव्य प्र जतकू ल प्र भाव डालते ै क ; या (ड.) उसने अपने पि का इस प्र कार िु रुपययोगग दकया ै , जिससे दक उसका अपने पि पर बने रैना लयोगक जैत के प्र जतकू ल ै योग गया ै , या (च) किाचार, िु व्यधवैार या अिंता के आधार पर : परंतु जनिेिक कयोग उसके पि से सुनवाई का युजततयुतत अवसर दिए जबना रर इस संबंध ंें कें द्र ीय सरकार द्व ारा गरित दकसी सजंजत द्व ारा िांच करवाए जबना खंड (ख) से (च) ंें जवजनर्ि ध ष्‍ट ट दकसी आधार पर नैकि ै टाया िाएगा । 9. ं ु ख् यालय या तनाती का स्ट् थान – जनिेिक का ंुख् यालय ियोगरैाट , असं ंें ै योगगा । 10. जनिेिक का वेतन, भत्ते , इत्या दि- जनिेिक का वेतन, वेतन-ंररतस (1,44,200-2,18,200 रु पए) के वेतन-स्ट् तर 14 ंें जनधाधररत की िाएगा रर वै ऐसे भत्तक व अन्य प्र सुजवधाएं प्र ाप्त करेगा , ियोग भारत सरकार के संकि रैंक के दकसी अजधकारी कयोग अनुा मेय ैैः परन्तु यदि जनिेिक के पप ंें जनयुक्त कयोगई व्य जक्त पेंिन , उपिान, अजभिायी भजवष्‍टय जनजध ंें जनययोगिक अजभिाय के पप ंें कयोगई सेवाजनवृजत प्र सुजवधाएं या सेवाजनवृजत प्र सुजवधाओं के अन्य पप, प्र ाप्त करता ै या प्र ाप्त कर चुका ै या प्र ाप्त करने का ै किार बना ै तयोग ऐसे जनिेिक के वेतन ंे से पेिंन की सकल रकं या अजभिायी भजवष्‍टय जनजध ंें जनययोगिक का अजभिाय या सेवाजनवृजत प्र सुजवधाओं का कयोगई अन्य पप, यदि कयोगई (उपिान के संान पेिंन के जसवाय) उसके द्व ारा आहृत दकया गया ै या आहृत दकया िाना ै , घटाया िाएगाैः परन्तु यै रर दक जनिेिक की जनयुजक्त के पश्चात न तयोग वेतन रर भत्तक ंें रर न ै ी सेवा के अन्य जनबंधनक रर ितों ंें उसके अजैतकर पप ंें पररवतधन दकया िाएगा। 11. या्ा भत्ता - जनिेिक, प्र वास पर या स्ट् थानांतरण के िौरान (जिसके अंतगधत संस्ट्थान ंें पिभार ्ै ण करने के जलए की गई या्ा या संस्ट्थान ंें उसकी पिावजध की संाजप्त पर अपने गृै नगर प्रस्ट् थान करने के जलए) या्ा भत्ते इत्यादि का वसे ै ी ै किार ै योगगा , िसे के न्द्रीय सरकार के संान स्ट् तर के दकसी अजधकारी कयोग लागू ै योगते ैैं । 12. छु ट्ट ी ं ं िूर करने वाला प्र ाजधकारी - अध्यि , जनिेिक की छु ट्टी ं िूंर करने वाला प्र ाजधकारी ै योगगा । 13. जविेि ंें सरकारी या्ा एं- जनिेिक द्व ारा जविेि ंें सरकारी या्ाएं के वल अध्यि द्व ारा िारी आिेिक के अनुसार रर के न्द्रीय सरकार के अनुंयोगिन से की िाएगी, रर वै ऐसी या्ा के संबंध ंें ऐसे भत्ते , ऐसी िरक पर आहृत करने का ै किार ै योगगा िसे के न्द्रीय सरकार के संान स्ट् तर के दकसी अजधकारी कयोग लागू ैैं । 14. जचदकत्सा उपचार ैे तु सुजवधाएं - जनिेिक के न्द्रीय स्ट् वास्ट््य सेवाओं ंें यथाउपबंजधत जचदकत्सा उपचार रर अस्ट्पताल सुजवधाओं का ै किार ै योगगा रर ऐसे स्ट् थानक ंें िैां के न्द्र ीय स्ट् वास्ट््य सेवाएं प्र चालन ंें नैकि ै , वैां जनिेिक के न्द्र ीय सेवाएं (जचदकत्सीय पररचयाध) जनयं ,1954 ंें यथाउपबंजधत सुजवधाओं का ै किार ै योगगा । 15. आवास- जनिेिक के न्द्रीय सरकार के संान स्ट् तर के दकसी अजधकारी कयोग यथालागू जनवासी आवास का ै किार ै योगगा । 16. वाैन की सुजवधा- जनिेिक, भारत सरकार के संान स्ट् तर के दकसी अजधकारी कयोग यथा अनुा मेय वाैन सुजवधा का ै किार ै योगगा । [रा.सं.पी-24024/53/2020-आईपीआर-V] रववंद्र , संयुक्त सजचव P-24024/53/2020-IPR-V 282185/2021/IPR-V 572/1231 -- 3 of 117 -- 4 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(i)] MINISTRY OF COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY (Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade) NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the 30th December, 2020 G.S.R. 819 (E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (a) of sub-section (2) of section 38 read with sub-section (1) of section 18 of the National Institute of Design Act, 2014 (18 of 2014)the Central Government hereby makes the following rules, regulating, the method of recruitment, salary, allowances, and other conditions of service for the post of Director in National Institute of Design, Assam, namely:- 1. Short title and commencement.- (1) These rules may be called the Director, National Institute of Design, Assam (Recruitment, Salary, Allowances and other Conditions of Service) Rules, 2020. (2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 2. Definitions.- (1) In these rules, unless the context otherwise requires,- (a) ‘Act’ means the National Institute of Design Act, 2014 (18 of 2014); (b) ‘Chairman’ means the Chairman of the Governing Council of the Institute; (c) ‘Director’ means the Director of the Institute; (d) ‘Institute’ means the National Institute of Design, Assam; (e) ‘Selection Committee’ means a selection committee constituted for the Institute, by the Central Government under sub-section (2) of section 18 of the Act. (2) Words and expressions used and not defined in these rules, but defined in the National Institute of Design Act, 2014 shall have the same meanings respectively assigned to them in that Act. 3. Educational qualifications, experience etc. for appointment of Director.-A person shall not be appointed as Director, unless he,- (a) has Masters Degree in Engineering or Technology or Design; (b) should have minimum of fifteen years’ experience in teaching or Industry or Research; (c) should have proven record of significant contributions made in the field of Technology or design with national or international exposure. 4. Method of Appointment.– (1) Recruitment to the post of Director shall be made by a Selection Committee constituted by the Central Government. (2) The Selection Committee shall follow its own procedure for recommending a suitable person for the post of Director. 5. Disqualification.- No person,- (a)who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or (b) who having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any person from the operation of this rule. 6. Power to relax.- Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it may, by order, for reason to be recorded in writing and in consultation with the competent authority, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 7. Term of office.– The Director shall hold the office for a term of five years from the date on which he enters upon office or attains the age of sixty years whichever is earlier. 8. Resignation and termination.– (1) The Director shall give three months’ prior notice in writing to the Chairman, if he intends to resign from the post: P-24024/53/2020-IPR-V 282185/2021/IPR-V 573/1231 -- 4 of 117 -- [भाग II—खण्ड 3(i)] भारत का रािप् : असाधारण 5 Provided that the Director shall, unless he is permitted by the Central Government to relinquish the post sooner, continue to hold the post until the expiry of the period of notice or until the time a person duly appointed as his successor joins or until the expiry of his term, whichever is earlier. (2) The Central Government may, remove a person from the post of Director,– (a) who has been adjudged an insolvent; or (b) who has been convicted of an offence which, in the opinion of the Central Government, involves moral turpitude; or (c) who has become physically or mentally incapable of acting as Director; or (d) who has acquired such financial or other interest as is likely to affect prejudicially his functions as Director; or (e) who has so abused his position as to render his continuance in the post prejudicial to the public interest, or (f) on ground of misconduct, misbehavior or incapacity: Provided that the Director shall not be removed on any of the grounds specified in clauses (b) to (f) without giving him a reasonable opportunity of being heard and holding an enquiry in this regard by a Committee constituted by the Central Government. 9. Head Quarter or place of posting.– The headquarter of the Director shall be at Jorhat, Assam. 10. Salary, allowances etc. of the Director.– The Director’s pay shall be fixed in level 14 in the pay matrix (Rs.1,44,200 – 2,18,200) plus allowances and other benefits, as are admissible to an Officer of equivalent rank in the Government of India: Provided that in case a person appointed as a Director, is in receipt of, or has received or has become entitled to receive any retirement benefits by way of pension, gratuity, employers contribution to the Contributory Provident Fund or other form of retirement benefits, the pay of such Director shall be reduced by the gross amount of pension or employers contribution to the Contributory Provident Fund or any other form of retirement benefits, if any (except pension equivalent of gratuity), drawn or to be drawn by him: Provided further that neither the salary and allowances nor the other terms and conditions of service of the Director shall be varied to the disadvantage after his appointment. 11. Travelling Allowances.– The Director, while on tour or on transfer (including the journey undertaken to join the Institute or on the expiry of his term with the Institute to proceed to his home town) shall be entitled to travelling allowance etc., as are applicable to an officer of equal status of the Central Government. 12. Leave Sanctioning Authority.– The Chairman shall be the leave sanctioning authority of Director. 13. Official visits abroad.– Official visits abroad by the Director shall be undertaken only in accordance with orders issued by the Chairman and with the approval of Central Government, and he shall be entitled to draw such allowances in respect of such visits at the same rates as are applicable to an officer of equal status of the Central Government. 14. Facility for medical treatment.– The Director shall be entitled to medical treatment and hospital facilities as provided in the Central Health Services and in places where Central Health Services are not in operation, Director shall be entitled to the facilities as provided in the Central Services (Medical Attendance) Rules, 1954. 15. Accommodation.– The Director shall be entitled for residential accommodation as applicable to an officer of equal status of the Central Government. 16. Facility of conveyance.– The Director shall be entitled for conveyance facilities as admissible to an officer of equal status of the Government of India. [F. No. P-24024/53/2020-IPR-V] RAVINDER, Jt. Preparation and submission of annual statement of accounts of the Institute.– (1) The Institute shall prepare its annual statement of accounts and balance sheet showing the financial results as specified in Form ‘A’ and Form ‘B’ and the Schedules annexed to these rules. (4) The books of Accounts will be maintained on the basis of double entry book keeping system. 5. Educational qualifications, experience etc. for appointment of Director.-A person shall not be appointed as Director, unless he,- (a) has Masters Degree in Engineering or Technology or Design; (b) should have minimum of fifteen years’ experience in teaching or Industry or Research; (c) should have proven record of significant contributions made in the field of Technology or design with national or international exposure. 4. Power to relax.- Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it may, by order, for reason to be recorded in writing and in consultation with the competent authority, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 7. Term of office.– The Director shall hold the office for a term of five years from the date on which he enters upon office or attains the age of sixty years which ever is earlier. 8. Resignation and termination. – (1) The Director shall give three months’ prior notice in writing to the Chairman, if he intends to resign from the post: Provided that the Director shall, unless he is permitted by the Central Government to relinquish the post sooner, continue to hold the post until the expiry of the period of notice or until the time a person duly appointed as his successor joins or until the expiry of his term, whichever is earlier. (2) The Central Government may, remove a person from the post of Director,– (a) who has been adjudged an insolvent; or (b) who has been convicted of an offence which, in the opinion of the Central Government, involves moral turpitude; or (c) who has become physically or mentally incapable of acting as Director; or (d) who has acquired such financial or other interest as is likely to affect prejudicially his functions as Director; or (e) who has so abused his position as to render his continuance in the post prejudicial to the public interest, or (f) on ground of misconduct, misbehavior or incapacity: Provided that the Director shall not be removed on any of the grounds specified in clauses (b) to (f) without giving him a reasonable opportunity of being heard and holding an enquiry in this regard by a Committee constituted by the Central Government. 9. Head Quarter or place of posting.– The headquarter of the Director shall be at Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. Preparation and submission of annual statement of accounts of the Institute.– (1) The Institute shall prepare its annual statement of accounts and balance sheet showing the financial results as specified in Form ‘A’ and Form ‘B’ and the Schedules annexed to these rules. (2) The annual statement of accounts and balance sheet of the Institute, duly authenticated by the Director and passed by the Governing Council shall be forwarded to the Comptroller and Auditor General of India, not later than the 31st day of July every year. (3) The duly audited annual statement of accounts of the Institute as certified by the Comptroller and Auditor General of India together with the audit report thereon shall be forwarded by the Director for every financial year to the Central Government by the 30th day of September of the following year for laying before the both Houses of Parliament. (4) The books of Accounts will be maintained on the basis of double entry book keeping system. 5. Separate ledger accounts for funds received from the Government of India.—The Institute shall maintain separate ledger accounts for all funds received from the Government of India and maintain accounts of the Institute regarding proper utilisation of such grants. Short title and commencement.- (1) These rules may be called the Director, National Institute of Design, Haryana (Recruitment, Salary, Allowances and other Conditions of Service) Rules, 2020. (2) Words and expressions used and not defined in these rules, but defined in the National Institute of Design Act, 2014 shall have the same meanings respectively assigned to them in that Act. 3. Educational qualifications, experience etc. for appointment of Director.- A person shall not be appointed as Director, unless he,- (a) has Masters Degree in Engineering or Technology or Design; (b) should have minimum of fifteen years’ experience in teaching or Industry or Research; (c) should have proven record of significant contributions made in the field of Technology or design with national or international exposure. 4. (2) The Selection Committee shall follow its own procedure for recommending a suitable person for the post of Director. 5. Disqualification.- No person,- (a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or (b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any person from the operation of this rule. 6. Power to relax.- Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it may, by order, for reason to be recorded in writing and in consultation with the competent authority, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 7. Term of office.– The Director shall hold the office for a term of five years from the date on which he enters upon office or attains the age of sixty years, whichever is earlier. 8. Resignation and termination.– (1) The Director shall give three months’ prior notice in writing to the Chairman, if he intends to resign from the post: Provided that the Director shall, unless he is permitted by the Central Government to relinquish the post sooner, continue to hold the post until the expiry of the period of notice or until the time a person duly appointed as his successor joins or until the expiry of his term, whichever is earlier. (2) The Central Government may, remove a person from the post of Director,- (a) who has been adjudged an insolvent; or (b) who has been convicted of an offence which, in the opinion of the Central Government, involves moral turpitude; or (c) who has become physically or mentally incapable of acting as Director; or (d) who has acquired such financial or other interest as is likely to affect prejudicially his functions as Director; or (e) who has so abused his position as to render his continuance in the post prejudicial to the public interest, or (f) on ground of misconduct, misbehavior or incapacity: Provided that the Director shall not be removed on any of the grounds specified in clauses (b) to (f) without giving him a reasonable opportunity of being heard and holding an enquiry in this regard by a Committee constituted by the Central Government. 9. Head Quarter or place of posting.– The headquarter of the Director shall be at Kurukshetra, Haryana. Educational qualifications, experience etc. for appointment of Director.-A person shall not be appointed as Director, unless he,- (a) has Masters Degree in Engineering or Technology or Design; (b) should have minimum of fifteen years’ experience in teaching or Industry or Research; (c) should have proven record of significant contributions made in the field of Technology or design with national or international exposure. 4. Method of Appointment.– (1) Recruitment to the post of Director shall be made by a Selection Committee constituted by the Central Government. (2) The Selection Committee shall follow its own procedure for recommending a suitable person for the post of Director. 5. Disqualification.- No person,- (a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or (b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any person from the operation of this rule. 6. Power to relax.- Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it may, by order, for reason to be recorded in writing and in consultation with the competent authority, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 7. Term of office.– The Director shall hold the office for a term of five years from the date on which he enters upon office or attains the age of sixty years, whichever is earlier. 8. Resignation and termination.– (1) The Director shall give three months’ prior notice in writing to the Chairman, if he intends to resign from the post: Provided that the Director shall, unless he is permitted by the Central Government to relinquish the post sooner, continue to hold the post until the expiry of the period of notice or until the time a person duly appointed as his successor joins or until the expiry of his term, whichever is earlier. Leave Sanctioning Authority.– The Chairman shall be the leave sanctioning authority of Director. 13. Official visits abroad.– Official visits abroad by the Director shall be undertaken only in accordance with orders issued by the Chairman and with the approval of Central Government, and he shall be entitled to draw such allowances in respect of such visits at the same rates as are applicable to an officer of equal status of the Central Government. 14. Accommodation.– The Director shall be entitled for residential accommodation as applicable to an officer of equal status of the Central Government. 16.
